title: Cohu to Host Investor Day on November 10, 2026
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Cohu, Inc's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.

## Cohu to Host Investor Day on November 10, 2026


October 8, 2026


[PDF Version](https://cohu.gcs-web.com/node/20001/pdf)


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 8, 2026-- Cohu, Inc. (NASDAQ: COHU), a global supplier of equipment and services optimizing semiconductor manufacturing yield and productivity, today announced they will host an Investor Day on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, in New York City from 9:00 a.m. to 12 p.m. Eastern Time.


Cohu's senior leadership team will provide a business update focusing on our strategy, growth platforms, financial targets and capital priorities. The event will also feature a keynote address from AMD, one of Cohu’s largest customers and a global leader in high-performance and AI computing, providing investors with an industry perspective on the market forces driving demand for advanced semiconductor technology.


This event will have in-person participation by invitation only, as well as virtual attendance via webcast. Registration for the webcast is available now at[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/nonvv9ce](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Fnonvv9ce&esheet=54616643&newsitemid=20261008080990&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Fnonvv9ce&index=1&md5=70d5fb29561d096520c9f2086ed6ff08) .


An audio-video replay of the event, along with the associated presentation material will be accessible from the Cohu Investor Relations website after the conclusion of the event.


If you are a buy-side institutional investor or a sell-side equity analyst interested in attending the event in person, please contactmatt.hutton@cohu.com .

Cohu assumes no obligation to update the information in this release.


**About Cohu:**


Cohu (NASDAQ: COHU) was founded in 1947 and is a global technology leader supplying test, automation, inspection & metrology products, software analytics solutions and services to the semiconductor industry. Additional information can be found at[www.cohu.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.cohu.com&esheet=54616643&newsitemid=20261008080990&lan=en-US&anchor=www.cohu.com&index=2&md5=de97324bcf8e7663943add6c773bc6d8) .
